dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: O—One moment please...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: If I had known you'd pay me a visit, I would have spent more time getting ready...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Haha, you've no need to worry.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The sights here are nothing like what I've seen at home. There are new wonders to be found with each step.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But there's also an added layer of significance to it, because this place belongs to you.

choices.text: Make yourself at home. I mean it quite literally, haha.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: That would be too unseemly...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: However, I appreciate your kindness.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's my pleasure.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ahaha... That's very considerate of you. However, you don't have to go above and beyond for me.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Please let me know if you ever need my assistance. I hope I can be of some help to you too.

choices.text: I hope that it's a place where you can let go of your worries and just relax.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Hm... I appreciate your kindness.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I wouldn't dare "let go" and "relax." However, I am more than grateful for being able to rest here for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you want to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I'd be delighted. What would you like to talk about...?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: My affection for the arts stems from the education I received at home.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Whenever I try to delve deeper into the meaning behind the words of a poem, I gain a better understanding of the author's state of mind.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Through the author's eyes, I can immerse myself in the sights that only they have seen. Even if the subject is well-known to me, I am able to gain a deeper level of appreciation for it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I feel the same way.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: "Camellia petals fall to the ground, scattered among the raindrops of yesterday."

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Just reading it makes me sentimental. This must be what people call "the power of art."

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ah... How rude of me to talk about my own interests all the time.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Even though I initially wanted to take this opportunity to learn more about you...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Would you mind if I took up a bit more of your time? Tell me about the things you like.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: ...Is that alright?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Talking about the beauty of nature, it is important to mention that the people of Inazuma believe that everything has its own spiritual essence.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Even though we might be familiar with the way nature looks on the surface, each type of scenery evokes a different kind of "feeling."

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: At least, that's a romantic way of approaching this topic.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hm... Would you like to exchange views on the art of tea-making?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: In other words... Do you want to try my home-made matcha?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I have read in a book before that Mondstadt and Liyue each have their own, unique tea cultures.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But when it comes to the intricacies of tea-making, the people of Inazuma also have their insights.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I'd like you to try some authentic Inazuma Matcha and tell me what you think!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps your feedback will also deepen my understanding of the tea ceremony.

choices.text: I'm pretty sure that someone of your status shouldn't be making tea for me.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Please don't say that.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: You're the one who's embarked on epic journeys to distant places and achieved many great feats.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: The title of "the daughter of the Kamisato Clan" and involvement in the Yashiro Commission pales in comparison to the depths of your experiences.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: More importantly... I hope that, between the two of us, we need not be concerned with our identities...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I'll just think of you as... my closest confidant.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Closest confidant...)

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Can I... hold your hand?

choices.text: Let me make some desserts to go along with the tea.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: ...Really?!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ahem... Please excuse my lack of manners. It is because I'm excited.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Being able to enjoy tea with my closest confidant — it feels like I'm in a dream...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Ayaka.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: With the cerulean sky and chirping birds accompanying you today, I am certain you will have a pleasant journey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodnight, Ayaka.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: What a soothing evening.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...Or is it because you are here with me?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Hehe, good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Do you want to chat?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Anything you want to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: These stalls look to have been quite carefully arranged.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It's a little deserted here, but it's enough for us to put aside our troubles and enjoy some festive fun and relaxation. Even if it's just the two of us, and even if it's our own kind of festival.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Thank you. This truly makes me happy.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Having a dojo in one's home is akin to placing one's sword on the table. It is a reminder to never be negligent.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: One of the fundamental principles of the Kamisato Art of Tachi Jutsu is to constantly sharpen your mind, as you would a blade.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Since we're both here, would you like to train together?
